nodes.label: Committer role
nodes.content: The committer role checks repository type at pipeline start and finalizes commits after review, using Jujutsu when .jj exists and enforcing atomic commit quality.

nodes.label: Jujutsu-aware workflow
nodes.content: When .jj exists, roles use Jujutsu rather than Git, describe or edit item commits, preserve atomic changes, absorb fixes, and verify status and log.

edges.evidence: The role forbids Git commands in a .jj repository and requires atomic commit-quality verification and jj absorb.
